### 🟢 Approval recommended The two-line change is a correct, index-aligned fix in a pure display helper, fully traced and backed by a passing regression test. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes a display bug in `modelChoices` (the shared model-presentation helper in `@chroxy/store-core`). When two custom models shared the same base label and produced the same "pinned" collision descriptor (e.g. both resolving to `Custom (pinned 1.0)`), the final full-ID fallback re-read the already-decorated label and emitted a doubled descriptor like `Custom (pinned 1.0) (claude-alpha-1-0)`. The fix reads the original base label from the index-aligned `unique[index]` entry instead of the mutated `choices` element, producing the intended `Custom (claude-alpha-1-0)` while preserving selection IDs and source rows. **Changes:** - In `modelChoices`, the final collision-resolution map now computes the base label from `unique[index]` (the original, un-decorated model) rather than from the already-relabeled `choices` element. - Added a regression test covering cross-family colliding pinned descriptors, asserting correct labels, ID/fullId preservation, input immutability, and `findModelEntry` resolution. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/​store-core/​src/​model-display.ts | Uses the original base label (`unique[index]`) in the full-ID fallback to avoid repeating the pinned descriptor. | | packages/​store-core/​src/​model-display.test.ts | Adds a regression test for colliding pinned descriptors verifying labels, IDs, immutability, and entry resolution. |
Review effort: Balanced
